## Column Body Outset Test

This tests the `.column-body-outset` class which extends content slightly beyond the body column.

::: {.column-body-outset}
OUTSET-CONTENT: This content should extend slightly beyond the normal body width, creating a subtle visual emphasis without going full-width.
:::

Regular text for comparison.

In HTML, body-outset provides a middle ground between body width and page width.
